name: PCI Express 3.0
bandwidth_basis: x16, PER DIRECTION. PCI-SIG quotes PCIe bandwidth per lane per direction. PCIe 3.0 runs at 8 GT/s with 128b/130b coding: 8 x 128/130 / 8 = 0.985 GB/s per lane per direction, x16 = 15.75 GB/s per direction. The bidirectional aggregate is 31.5 GB/s. This follows the same convention as pcie-gen4 (31.5 GB/s per direction) and pcie-gen5 (63.0 GB/s per direction).
topology: Point-to-point host-to-device (root complex to endpoint), up to 16 lanes. Becomes a shared fabric only via PCIe switches or host bridges.
switching: Optional PCIe switch, store-and-forward, no in-network reduction.
notes: PCIe 3.0 is the generation used by the Horizon Journey 5 automotive SoC (PCIe Gen3 2-lane). At 15.75 GB/s per direction at x16, it is roughly 28x below NVLink 4's 450 GB/s per direction per GPU. The direction convention is the same as pcie-gen4 and pcie-gen5: per lane per direction, not aggregate.
